# laravelforge_site_npm_credential (Resource)

Manages NPM registry authentication credentials for a Laravel Forge site, keyed by registry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `registry` (String) The NPM registry URL the credential authenticates against. Acts as the credential's identifier.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server hosting the site.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the credential belongs to.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The authentication token for the registry.
